title: NZCF seeks interest in a Director of Competitions role
summary: NZCF is inviting expressions of interest in a proposed role supporting the organisation of its competitions.
content:
The New Zealand Chess Federation is exploring a Director of Competitions position and welcomes expressions of interest.

The proposed work spans competition planning, coordination with organisers, officials, venues and equipment, budgets, sponsorship and promotion. Responsibilities and remuneration are open for discussion with NZCF.

Anyone interested should read the original notice for the proposed duties and contact details.

[Read the NZCF announcement](https://www.newzealandchess.co.nz/newsarticle/171126?newsfeedId=2378072)

Source: New Zealand Chess Federation, 13 October 2026.

title: 2027 World Senior Team Championship — Germany
summary: NZCF has shared entry information for the 50+ and 65+ team championships in Magdeburg, with upcoming deadlines for New Zealand players.
content:
Magdeburg, Germany will host the 2027 World Senior Team Chess Championship, with arrival on **31 March** and departure on **11 April 2027**. The event includes Open and Women’s categories for players aged 50+ and 65+.

Entries must go through a national federation. NZCF invites applications from groups of at least four players by **30 November 2026**. Individuals seeking teammates should contact NZCF by **31 October 2026**; NZCF may share their details with other interested players.

Players fund their own participation, and the event requires accommodation booked through the organiser. Read the original notice and official regulations for the full eligibility, booking and entry conditions.

[Read the NZCF notice and entry instructions](https://www.newzealandchess.co.nz/newsarticle/171123?newsfeedId=2378072)

Source: New Zealand Chess Federation, 13 October 2026.
